newsitem.title: UK: LLP to market world's largest maritime database.
newsitem.headline: LLP to market world's largest maritime database.

text.p: UK publisher LLP has signed a deal with Lloyd's Register, the ship classification society, to create the world's largest commercial database of maritime information, LLP said on Tuesday.

Under a five-year contract LLP will add information drawn from Lloyd's Register's shipping databases to its own electronic products and services. LLP's existing databases are updated constantly, with over 3.5 million changes each year.
The new service will extend from LLP's international shipping movements and casualty reports to Lloyd's Register's ship characteristics and new vessel construction data.
LLP Limited, formerly the publishing arm of the LLoyd's of London insurance market, was subject to a management buyout in December 1995.
It is the world's leading maritime publisher, its 300 publications including daily newspaper Lloyd's List.
LLP has said that it plans a flotation but has not yet announced a timetable for this.
